diagnostics.information_criterion_note: Poisson likelihood relative constants omitted; compare only identical observations and windows.
diagnostics.covariance_method: scaled sparse Gram matrix; condition cutoff 1e6
diagnostics.uncertainty: Local Gaussian approximation; fixed lifetimes have zero error. IRF noise and boundary effects excluded.

amplitude_convention: Underlying exponential amplitude at lag zero, before bin averaging; IRF has unit sum.
uncertainty_note: Local Gaussian standard errors, conditional on the measured IRF; not confidence intervals.
